title: USGS seismic sensors track booms toward Area 51

tellings.quote: It had detected um booms, site booms, coming in from the Pacific heading towards Area 51 in Nevada.

plain: In the late 1980s, sensors run by the US Geological Survey, the government's earth science agency, picked up sonic booms coming in from the Pacific and heading toward Area 51, the secret military test site in Nevada. A researcher named Nick Cook tells this on the show without naming a source, as a sign that something fast and unacknowledged was flying to the base.
